name: vtable
meaning: 0x5742D0 base, 0x574308 joystick, 0x574314 keyboard, 0x574334 mouse. Three slots: [0] scalar deleting dtor, [1] SetAcquired, [2] Update.

name: acquired
meaning: 1 while the DirectInput device is acquired; Update refuses to run when it is 0.

name: deviceKind
meaning: 0 = joystick, 2 = keyboard, 4 = mouse: base ctor writes 0 (0x403f4a), joystick 0 (0x406df5), keyboard 2 (0x4072d8), mouse 4 (0x409ed5).

name: isDigital
meaning: 1 = digital device: InputMgr_Poll 0x52852d turns axisX/axisY into D-pad bits by sign against 0.0f (0x574300) and centres the analogue bytes at 0x80. 0 = analogue: axes are converted to bytes around 0x80. Writers: InputDevice_Construct 1 (base default), Keyboard_Construct 1, Joystick_Construct 0 (on the successful-init path), mouse 0x409E90 0.

name: axisX
meaning: Normalised X axis: clamp(raw/65535, -1, +1) * scaleX + offsetX. The input manager reads these.

name: axisY
meaning: Normalised Y axis, same formula.

name: axisZ
meaning: Normalised Z axis (throttle / PgUp-PgDn on the keyboard), same formula.

name: buttonPressed
meaning: Per-button output array: 1 when the button counts as pressed this frame after the blocked/repeat rules.

name: buttonCount
meaning: Number of buttons, capped at 0x100. 0x100 for the keyboard, 0xC for the joystick, 4 for the mouse.

name: pApp
meaning: Owning D3DApp; used for its hWnd in SetCooperativeLevel and to reach IDirectInput8.

name: rawX
meaning: Raw axis value in DirectInput units (-0xFFFF..+0xFFFF), written by the device-specific Update before it calls InputDevice_Update.

name: rawY
meaning: Raw Y axis, same convention.

name: rawZ
meaning: Raw Z axis, same convention.

name: buttonDown
meaning: Per-button current physical state, written by the device Update (high bit of DIJOYSTATE.rgbButtons for the joystick).

name: axisScaleX
meaning: Per-axis gain applied after normalisation; 1.0 by default, set by InputDevice_SetAxisCalibration from the input manager.

name: axisScaleY
meaning: Per-axis gain for Y.

name: axisScaleZ
meaning: Per-axis gain for Z.

name: axisOffsetX
meaning: Per-axis bias added after scaling; 0.0 by default (centre calibration).

name: axisOffsetY
meaning: Per-axis bias for Y.

name: axisOffsetZ
meaning: Per-axis bias for Z.

name: buttonBlocked
meaning: Per-button suppression mask: a non-zero entry forces buttonPressed to 0 for that button even while it is held.

name: allowHeld
meaning: 1 (the constructor default) means a button that was already down last frame still reports pressed; 0 turns buttonPressed into a rising-edge signal.

name: buttonDownPrev
meaning: Previous frame's buttonDown snapshot, updated at the end of InputDevice_Update.

name: pDevice
meaning: The DirectInput device. Vtable uses: GetCapabilities 0x0C, EnumObjects 0x10, GetProperty 0x14, SetProperty 0x18, Acquire 0x1C, Unacquire 0x20, GetDeviceState 0x24, SetDataFormat 0x2C, SetCooperativeLevel 0x34, GetObjectInfo 0x38, Poll 0x64.
